result: acted: opened PR #782 for cascade join 1 — the ITSM dispatch seam, the top buildable item in BUILD_BACKLOG "Next". lib/incident-playbook could decide a ticket was warranted and had no way to say so; the eight ITSM adapters could open one and had nothing telling them to; there was no code path between them. Added a pure total mapper (incidentToTicketRequest — the full priority × category matrix, no env/clock/IO) and a dispatch seam that resolves the emission gate first, so in this tree the answer is always suppressed and the result names which condition suppressed it. Fail-closed on seven paths with seven distinct named reasons, each leaving the incident open. Proof 23/23 with a 3/3 self-test, registered in scripts/package.json, root package.json, preflight.mjs and review-hub-ci.yml. Gates quoted: preflight PASSED 321 gates, verify:breadth PASSED 56 proofs, typecheck clean, review:invariants passed, test:api 409/409. THREE DEFECTS IN MY OWN FIRST DRAFT, fixed before pushing rather than shipped: (1) the proof header claimed a success path never written, and two of the six refusals live past the adapter factory which in this tree can never build one — so they were unreachable by any test, and a refusal nothing can reach is a comment, not a guard; the factory is now a parameter and all three are exercised. (2) That parameter exposed that the factory gates on process.env while the seam gates on the env it is handed, so a ticket opens only when BOTH agree — fail-closed either way, but accidental until written down and asserted. (3) A green tsx run is not a typecheck: the proof passed 23/23 while its adapter stand-in was missing two required fields, and preflight's typecheck caught it. Five preflight runs in total, each red on a real consequence of the change: proof:* 144→145 across five sentences, proof sources 143→144, preflight.mjs 742→743 lines, and the surface-coverage page regenerated with --write. Every figure updated at the sentence, never at the deriver. OWNER-MERGED: lib/* is owner-gated and nothing was self-merged. The three custody-ground-truth gaps are exhausted for the cloud lane — gap 1 is open as #720, gap 2 as #724, gap 3 is DR-020 territory.
